notes.title: Patch 1.1 - Tobii integration & major performance improvements
notes.content:
Patch 1.1 brings a bunch of quality of life tweaks, major performance improvements, and Tobii Eye Tracking integration.

Major changes:

Tobii Eye Tracking integration - activated in the options menu, requires a Tobii-integrated VIVE headset. You can teleport with gaze by holding the touchpad and releasing, or pick things up from afar by gazing at them and pulling the trigger.
Major performance increases - users should now have a significantly smoother experience.


Minor changes:

Dog will always follow you after you've collected the dog treats
Fixed an issue near the treasure chest
Added a shortcut to automatically complete the monolith puzzle, pressing M on the keyboard will allow you to skip this if desired.


- Mark

notes.title: Patch notes 1.01
notes.content:
This update addresses some minor bugs and tweaks.

List of changes:

    Fixed an issue where players were unable to access the inventory near the chest
    Tweaked the way the bow and arrow works. It should now feel more natural.
    The continue button will not be visible on the main menu if you don't have a save file (oops)


- Mark
